name: dspic33fj128mc804
description: Microchip dsPIC33FJ128MC804 (16-bit DSC, 44-pin, motor control, audio DAC): XC16 toolchain, Renode CPU.dsPIC33 core (dsPIC33F model)

image.notes: program word at ISA address a sits at 0x01000000 + 2a, 4 bytes (24-bit instruction + phantom byte), the byte layout of XC16 HEX files

renode.notes: 44-pin version of the MC802: PORTC (RC0-RC9 = RP16-RP25, 'portc OnGPIO n true'), AN6-AN8 on RC0-RC2, PWM2H1/L1 on RC6/RC7, audio DAC1 at 0x03F0 ('dac1 SampleCount 0', 'dac1 Samples 0 16', 'dac1 SampleRate'). Docs: tools/dspic30/PERIPHERALS_33F.md.

reference.simulator: none for dsPIC33F in sim30 (dspic30super only); the ISA is the dsPIC30F's (DS70157), verified with sim30; 33F differences are checked with self-checking firmware
